title.value: Scenario 1.1 - Serve BgZ resources of a patient

description.value: Prevalidation of scenario 1.1 of the BgZ MSZ 2.0 Serve use case. See [the test file on the Nictiz wiki](https://informatiestandaarden.nictiz.nl/wiki/bgz:V2.0_Testscript_BgZ_MSZ) for more information.
Enter the BSN of the test patient. Do not use a real BSN.
Serve zib-Patient instance including the patient's general practitioner and check the response
